page.layout: One page: a single engraved vignette (coat of arms with cartouche, medallion portrait and ribbons) in the centre; no running text. Handwritten shelfmark and library stamp below, not printed text.

main_text.l: GEORGIVS D.G. MAG. BRI. FRA. ET HIB. REX F.D. [?]

page.notes: Engraved bookplate or vignette, not a title page. Central coat of arms with a female head above it, flanked by scroll ornaments. Below, a circular medallion with a laureate portrait in profile, around which a legend runs. Ribbon scrolls on either side carry the words above. Small signature at lower left, probably "J. Pine" or similar, and at lower right "sculp" [?]. The ribbon and medallion legends are worn and only partly legible; the readings are uncertain and marked [?]. Not printed text, and so excluded: the handwritten shelfmark "234:90" and the library stamp "UNIVERSITY LIBRARY CAMBRIDGE". No page number, running head, catchword or signature.
